name: dsh-mobile
description: DeepSeek Harness 手机客户端(独立项目,不进入上游仓库)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsh-mobile/e2e-tunnel && npm run build -w @dsh-mobile/pairing && npm run build -w @dsh-mobile/ui-layout-mobile && npm run build -w @dsh-mobile/session-hydration && npm run build -w @dsh-mobile/mobile-web
scripts.test: npm test -w @dsh-mobile/e2e-tunnel && npm test -w @dsh-mobile/pairing && npm test -w @dsh-mobile/mobile-web && npm test -w relay && npm run audit:architecture
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dsh-mobile/e2e-tunnel && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-mobile/pairing && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-mobile/ui-layout-mobile && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-mobile/session-hydration && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-mobile/mobile-web
